acceptance_predicates.description: roles.remove removes the explicitly named assignment at the exact expected revision even when that assignment or another assignment has expired, provided the state and target have valid structure, registry references, and evidence.

roles.list, roles.check, role admission, and doctor continue to reject malformed, unknown, and expired assignments; removal continues to reject stale revisions, missing targets, malformed state, invalid registry, and invalid target structure.
Focused positive and negative tests cover unrelated expiry, target expiry, stale revision, malformed state, and fail-closed read/admission behavior, with documentation of the lifecycle distinction.

definition_of_done: Implement narrowly scoped roles.remove validation semantics without editing roles.json directly.
Add positive and negative tests and update public role-management documentation.
Run focused and applicable full gates, obtain independent review, exact-head CI, signed DCO integration, and post-merge verification.

inputs.description: Versioned role assignment state and registry validated by the existing role schemas.
Expected role-state revision supplied by the caller.

outputs.description: Signed implementation and durable evidence for safe expired-assignment cleanup.

gates.description: Targeted removal succeeds only for valid explicit targets and exact revisions.
Read, admission, malformed-input, and stale-revision paths remain fail-closed.
Clean signed DCO exact-head PR and post-merge state checks pass.
